content: Companies working with SMBs can offer their clients a professional white-label e-commerce platform by reselling Ecwid. Ecwid works with reseller partners like digital marketing agencies, hosting providers, website builders, and other SaaS platforms. Becoming an Ecwid reseller With Ecwid, you can have your store accounts on your own domain and customize what features to enable for clients. Ecwid's white-label solution allows you to: set any price you want for your clients feature your brand name and logos on the store account and login pages manage all your clients' accounts easily from one dashboard rely on a secure, hosted, and automatically updated cloud solution integrate the Ecwid storefront and control panel into your own platform via our Partner API To become an Ecwid partner: Sign up with your email and submit your company details Choose a partnership option that fits your needs. Submit the membership fee for your first year using the personal payment link that you will get via email. Submit your branding information for your white label platform (company name and logos). Once Ecwid gets your payment and branding information, your partner dashboard will be created within 5 business days so that you can start selling e-commerce. Partnership options Depending on the size of your business and the features you need, you can choose one of three partnership options. Silver: allows you to resell Ecwid as a private-label product with a basic partner dashboard for store management and a discount on subscription plans. Gold: gives access to Partner API for automated setup and management, custom WordPress plugin, priority support, and a discount on store subscription plans. Enterprise: suits large companies that are seeking a customized business solution, such as site builders, hosting companies, telcos, point-of-sale, and payment providers. Partnership fees There are two types of payments you’ll make within the partnership program depending on the partnership level and features you'd like to have. Annual fees When you join the program, you'll pay a partnership fee based on the partnership level you have chosen: | Partnership level | Annual fee | | Silver | $299 per year | | Gold | $899 per year | | Enterprise | Partnership fee is customized based on minimum monthly commitments | Monthly fees In addition to the annual fees, each month, you’ll be charged for all your clients’ active paid plans at a discounted partner rate depending on your partnership level. The subscription prices for Enterprise partners are negotiable based on the number of stores and minimum revenue commitments. Related articles Was this article helpful? Sorry about that!
